description: OptimistFi's perps desk: its stories, the traders directory with checked calls, and the Hyperliquid wallets it covered. Use when the user asks: latest perps news on X; is trader Y worth following. Args: view; market; trader; wallet; limit.

dex.description: account view only: Hyperliquid builder dex name, e.g. xyz; empty reads the main dex.
dex.title: Dex

market.description: news and traders: one market (BTC, NVDA, gold).
market.title: Market

max_age_s.description: account only: maximum source age in seconds, default 3. A stale or undated account is unavailable.
max_age_s.title: Max Age S

trader.description: traders: one trader by name or X handle.
trader.title: Trader

view.description: news: the desk's published perps stories, newest first. traders: the perps traders directory, with the desk's checked calls on each. wallets: the Hyperliquid wallets the desk has covered, with their stories. account: a fresh public Hyperliquid wallet state on one dex, with positions and margin; wallet is required.
view.title: View

wallet.description: wallets: one 0x address; adds what it holds now.
wallet.title: Wallet

name: get_perps_desk
title: Perps desk — news, traders and wallets
